data.body: Every other shared workflow in this repo (ai-pr-review.yml, ai-pr-review-address.yml, ai-issue-implementation.yml, notify.yml, issue-triage.yml, stale-issue-closer.yml) pairs `workflow_call:` with a direct top-level event trigger so the automation also runs on this repository's own issues/PRs, in addition to being callable by consumers. This new workflow defines only `workflow_call:`, so comments on this repository's own closed issues will never trigger a Slack notification unless a separate caller workflow is added later — the feature is effectively inert for the repo that owns it, inconsistent with every sibling workflow. Add a direct `issue_comment: types: [created]` trigger alongside `workflow_call:` so this repository benefits from the same automation it ships to consumers.
